entities.summary: Said, a notable figure in the history of Oman, associated with Al-Busaidi Dynasty and Zanzibar Empire (1804–1856). Preceded by Moresby Treaty and Busaidi. Their legacy influenced Sultan Said bin Sultan moves his capital to Zanzibar and Canning Award divides the Omani Empire between Muscat and Zanzibar.
